headlines.title: 반도체 덕에 … 3월 경상수지 흑자 373억달러 역대 최대
headlines.summary: 상품수지 흑자 작년대비 3.6배로 BTS 효과 여행수지 11년만에 흑자 반도체 수출 호조에 힘입어 3월 한국 경상수지가 사상 최대 규모 흑자를 기록했다. 35개월 연속 흑자 행진도 이어갔다. 한국은행이 8일 발표한 ‘국제수지(잠정)’ 통계에 따르면 3월 경상수지는 373억2710만 달러(약 54조8400억 원) 흑자로 집계됐다.

headlines.title: 농번기 인력난에 외국인 근로자 10.4만명 배정

headlines.title: 국민연금 수익률 年 7.5% 유지땐 2100년까지 버틴다지만 …
headlines.summary: 올들어 250兆 수익, 장기간 고수익 유지는 과제 보험료 적자 국면엔 수익률 하락 출산율·임금 상승폭 등도 변수 기금 불어난 지금이 '개혁 적기' 운용 독립성·전문성 뒷받침돼야 국민 노후를 책임지는 국민연금의 고수익 달성은 틀림없는 경사다. 지난해 기금 운용으로 231조원 넘는 수익을 낸 데 이어 올해도 1~4월에만 250조원 이상을 벌어들였다.

key_headlines.title: Kia Poised to Surpass Hyundai's Monthly Domestic Sales for First Time Since 1998 Group Merger
key_headlines.summary: Kia is expected to exceed Hyundai's monthly domestic sales in April for the first time following their 1998 group integration, driven by Hyundai's production challenges including component supplier fires and Palisade recalls.

key_headlines.title: Deputy PM Announces Multi-Homeowner Tax Exemption Ending, Shifting Real Estate Market toward Owner-Occupants
key_headlines.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Gu Yun-chul reports that the expiration of capital gains tax deferral for multi-property owners on January 23 is driving market restructuring toward owner-occupants, with consideration for adjusting landlord tax benefits.

key_headlines.title: Korea's Green Growth Fund Acts as Catalyst for 50 Trillion Won Global Projects
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's Green Growth Trust Fund, which invested approximately 200 billion won over 15 years, is effectively leveraging public funds to catalyze global green projects valued at around 50 trillion won.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Boom Drives Record Tax Revenue; Flexible Fiscal Policy Needed
key_headlines.summary: First-quarter GDP growth reached 1.7%, nearly double the Bank of Korea's forecast, with semiconductor exports driving unprecedented tax revenues, prompting calls for flexible fiscal policy to match the rapid economic growth.

key_headlines.title: KAIST Identifies Battery Degradation Mechanism, Opening Path to Extended EV Range
key_headlines.summary: Researchers at KAIST discovered the precise moment lithium metal batteries degrade, providing insights for designing superior anodes that could simultaneously increase electric vehicle range and extend battery lifespan.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing momentum from semiconductor industry strength, with April domestic sales showing notable shifts in market leadership. Kia Motors is poised to surpass Hyundai's monthly domestic sales for the first time since their 1998 group merger, reflecting structural changes in the automotive market. The government is actively reshaping the real estate market through tax policy adjustments aimed at increasing owner-occupant participation and reducing multi-property speculation. Additionally, Korea's Green Growth Fund continues to demonstrate effective public-private partnership, leveraging modest government investment to catalyze significantly larger global green energy projects.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's first-quarter economic growth exceeded forecasts, with real GDP expanding 1.7% quarter-over-quarter and 3.6% year-over-year, driven primarily by semiconductor sector strength and export growth. National income (GDI) growth was even more impressive at 7.5% quarterly and 12.3% year-over-year, reflecting strong export commodity pricing. Policymakers are reassessing fiscal policy frameworks, as the rapid semiconductor-driven growth is outpacing conventional GDP-based forecasting models, prompting calls for more flexible fiscal mechanisms. The government faces challenges in balancing growth stimulus with potential international trade tensions, particularly ahead of US-China summit talks.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korea's stock market reached record highs, with domestic stock-type ETF net assets surpassing 200 trillion won for the first time, representing 3.5% of KOSPI market capitalization. The explosive growth in ETF popularity reflects increased retail investor participation, with domestic stock-type ETF assets growing from 40 trillion won at year-end 2024 to 200 trillion won by May 2026. Banks are capitalizing on market bullishness, with ETF brokerage commission revenue increasing 16% and trust deposits reaching 90 trillion won. Total ETF net assets across all categories exceeded 450 trillion won, demonstrating strong investor appetite for structured investment vehicles amid favorable market conditions.
sections.Industry & Technology: Researchers at KAIST made a breakthrough in lithium metal battery technology, identifying the precise degradation mechanism that causes battery performance decline, offering critical design principles for improving EV range and battery longevity. The discovery enables engineers to design anode surfaces that allow uniform lithium deposition and removal, potentially reducing dead lithium formation and extending vehicle driving range. This advancement is particularly significant for next-generation energy storage systems and mobile device batteries, supporting South Korea's competitiveness in the growing EV market. The research demonstrates Korea's continued technological leadership in battery science, a critical component for global EV adoption.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices showed signs of moderation following the expiration of capital gains tax deferral for multi-property owners, with May's first week seeing a 0.18% weekly increase compared to 0.21% the previous week. Peripheral areas including Jung-gu (0.73%), Nowon-gu (0.31%), and Dobong-gu (0.31%) led appreciation, while high-priced Gangnam-gu declined 0.16%, reflecting market restructuring toward middle-class owner-occupants. Jeonse (lease deposit) prices in Seoul rose 0.23% weekly, surpassing the general price increase rate, raising concerns about potential supply constraints. The government is considering adjustments to registered tenant business income tax benefits to further encourage property market inventory, though policymakers face balancing act between stimulating supply and addressing affordability concerns.
sections.International Economy: The US federal court invalidated Trump administration's global tariffs on May 7, dealing a potential political blow ahead of midterm elections and complicating trade negotiations with China scheduled for May 14-15. The International Trade Court's decision emphasized the administration's confusion between international balance and trade balance concepts, undermining the legal justification for high tariff policies that have contributed to global trade uncertainty and inflation. South Korean exporters continue facing tariff uncertainty despite the court decision, as the administration may appeal or pursue alternative trade law mechanisms. Meanwhile, Korean cosmetics companies are capitalizing on shifts in global markets, with European exports surging 55.1% year-over-year as Chinese market dominance wanes.
sections.AI & Economy: Construction firm Keumdo signed a memorandum of understanding to build an AI data center in the Honam region, partnering with multiple specialized firms to advance Korea's AI infrastructure capabilities. Japanese demand for AI and digital transformation is attracting increased attention from Korean startups seeking market expansion, with Japanese government budgets for semiconductor and AI combined reaching 123 billion yen, representing a fourfold increase from the previous year. The semiconductor and AI sector's growing importance is driving investment in related industrial metals, particularly copper, expected to outperform gold and crude oil in the second half of 2026 as supply demand remains robust. Korean technology firms are positioning themselves to capture growing AI infrastructure opportunities both domestically and internationally.
sections.Others: Samsung Electronics' largest labor union agreed to return to negotiations after government mediation, scheduling post-adjustment procedures for May 11-12 ahead of a threatened May 21 general strike, marking the first official negotiation in 45 days. The union accepted government support for talks after the previous March 27 negotiation collapsed over a 50 trillion won performance bonus dispute. The Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry indicated that the US court's tariff ruling would have limited impact on domestic companies, though broader trade uncertainty remains. Professional golfer Ham Jeong-woo secured a co-23rd place finish in the LIV Golf Virginia tournament, continuing Korea's growing presence in international professional golf competition.
